status.summary:
Checked: Initial request lists six move-out items at 18 Brindle Row: cracked chipboard floor by the fireplace, living-room front blind, under-stairs cupboard handle, kitchen blind, bathroom toilet seat, front-gate hinge. Event 001 says it was logged from inspection notes with no photos or supporting documents. The attached Alder & Finch Repairs invoice NBL-019-INV-11 is for £174.00 and describes all six items as done. I found no landlord approval, no contractor assignment, no contractor message and no tenant or landlord confirmation anywhere in the case.
Missing or in conflict: 1) The invoice is dated 11 September 2025, which is after today (4 September 2025), so I cannot treat it as proof of completed work. 2) No event shows that anyone instructed Alder & Finch, or that the landlord approved the work or the £174.00 cost. 3) The invoice does not match the request: it says the lounge blind was removed and replaced with a new Venetian blind, where the request only said it needed repair. It says the floorboard was replaced and carpet reinstated, where the request said cracked chipboard beside the fireplace. The cost is a single lump sum with no breakdown per item. 4) There are no photos or completion evidence. 5) It is not stated whether the property is vacant or who the landlord contact is. 6) No keys were mentioned.
Decision needed: Confirm whether Alder & Finch were instructed and whether the work was actually done. If it was, tell me to inform the landlord of the result and the £174.00 invoice, stating that the cost was not approved beforehand and leaving the payment decision to the landlord. If it was not, tell me to request landlord approval for the six items before any contractor is assigned.
